analysts.as: Global regulatory volatility drives cyber resilience efforts

expert.text: Under the Cyber Resilience Act, manufacturers must send an early warning within 24 hours and a full notification within 72 hours via ENISA's platform.
Germany's NIS2 law took effect 5 December 2025: 24-hour early warning, 72-hour notification, and management liable for risk-management failures.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Name an owner for 24-hour CRA reporting and register on ENISA's reporting platform.
lens.ciso: Rehearse the 24-hour early warning and 72-hour notification for actively exploited flaws.
lens.cto: Check which connected products you place on the EU market fall under the Cyber Resilience Act.
lens.eng: Keep SBOMs and vulnerability handling ready for every product with digital elements.

line: Makers of connected products must report exploited flaws to the EU within 24 hours.
scope: Legal cyber duties such as CRA reporting and NIS2. Not AI rules.
